title: FedE2E: One-Shot Federated Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Closed-Loop Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing datasets. However, existing federated learning methods for autonomous driving typically require multi-round communication and lack closed-loop evaluation, while one-shot methods mainly focus on perception tasks. To address these limitations, we propose \method, a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving. It comprises multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation to distill knowledge from heterogeneous models. Closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive demonstrates the effectiveness of \method in both one-shot and multi-round federated learning. In the one-shot setting, it achieves a Driving Score of 55.85, which is 4.07 points higher than prior work. In the multi-round setting, it reaches 60.35 after five communication rounds, the best performance among all compared methods under the same number

translated_title: FedE2E：面向端到端自动驾驶的带闭环评估的一次性联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习能够在不共享数据集的情况下实现协同模型训练。然而，现有的自动驾驶联邦学习方法通常需要多轮通信且缺乏闭环评估，而一次性联邦学习方法则主要专注于感知任务。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了FedE2E，一种面向端到端自动驾驶的一次性联邦学习方法。该方法包含多客户端校准、基于锚点的特征对齐以及词元级共识蒸馏，以从异构模型中蒸馏知识。在Bench2Drive上的闭环评估证明了FedE2E在一次性和多轮联邦学习中的有效性。在一次性设置下，它取得了55.85的驾驶分数，比先前工作高出4.07分；在多轮设置下，经过五轮通信后达到60.35，是同等通信轮数下所有对比方法中的最佳性能。
tldr: 提出首个面向端到端自动驾驶的一次性联邦学习方法FedE2E，通过多客户端校准、锚点特征对齐和词元级共识蒸馏从异构模型中蒸馏知识，在Bench2Drive闭环评估中一次性驾驶分数达55.85，超过先前工作4.07分。
